articles.title_cn: 哪些实验检验一个模型？
articles.abstract_en: Given a model of preferences, what choice data or experiment is sufficient to definitively test whether a subject is consistent with the model or to classify them into some “type” within the model? We characterize all experiments that test or classify a given model using a novel graph-theoretic construction: the labeled permutohedron. We show how these results can be used to identify the smallest experiments that achieve a particular goal.
articles.abstract_cn: 给定一个偏好模型，哪些选择数据或实验足以明确检验一个主体是否与该模型一致，或将其归类为模型中的某种“类型”？我们利用一种新颖的图论构造——带标签的置换多面体，刻画了所有能够检验或分类给定模型的实验。我们展示了如何利用这些结果识别实现特定目标的最小实验。

articles.title_en: Expectation and confusion: Evidence and theory
articles.title_cn: 期望与困惑：证据与理论
articles.abstract_en: In this paper, we characterize a forecasting model where forecasters cannot perfectly distinguish between the two persistent components (trends and cycles) in a dynamic setting. In this model, forecasters jointly update their beliefs about the two components: noisy information about one component is used to update beliefs about the other component. We present diagnostic empirical facts on forecasting behaviors and show that these facts are consistent with our model’s predictions while contradicting those of existing models in the expectation formation literature. To validate our model, we exploit the Federal Reserve’s 2012 adoption of explicit inflation targeting as a policy shock. Structural estimation reveals that this policy change altered the underlying data-generation process, and the corresponding changes in forecasting behavior indeed align with our model’s predictions. Finally, we characterize how this rational confusion mechanism interacts with behavioral biases such as overconfidence and show that this interaction can address the well-known persistent forecast error puzzle in the literature.
articles.abstract_cn: 在本文中，我们描述了一个预测模型，其中预测者无法完美地区分动态环境中的二持久成分（趋势和周期）。在该模型中，预测者共同更新他们对 二 组件的信念：有关 一 组件的噪声信息用于更新对另一个组件的信念。我们提出了有关预测行为的诊断性经验事实，并表明这些事实与我们模型的预测一致，但与预期形成文献中现有模型的预测相矛盾。为了验证我们的模型，我们利用美联储2012采用明确的通胀目标作为政策冲击。结构估计表明，这一政策变化改变了基础数据生成过程，并且预测行为的相应变化确实与我们模型的预测一致。最后，我们描述了这种理性混淆机制如何与过度自信等行为偏差相互作用，并表明这种相互作用可以解决文献中众所周知的持续预测误差难题。

articles.abstract_en: I derive a model of choice bracketing from two behavioral axioms in an expected utility framework. The first behavioral axiom establishes a link between narrow bracketing and correlation neglect. The second behavioral axiom identifies the reference point as the connector between broad and narrow preferences. The narrow bracketer is characterized by an inability to process changes from the reference point in different dimensions simultaneously. As a result, her tradeoffs between dimensions are distorted. She evaluates dimensions in isolation, implying a disregard for how they affect one another. When evaluating a dimension, she remains anchored to the reference point in the respective other dimension. This implies that she mistakenly perceives preference interactions in relation to the reference point. I present applications to portfolio choice, consumption bundle choice, and an exchange economy.
articles.abstract_cn: 我在期望效用框架下，从二行为公理推导出选择分组模型。第一行为公理建立了狭义分组与相关性忽视之间的联系。第二行为公理将参照点确定为广义偏好与狭义偏好之间的连接点。狭义分组者的特征是无法同时处理来自参照点在不同维度上的变化。因此，她在维度之间的权衡被扭曲。她孤立地评估各维度，意味着忽视了它们如何相互影响一。在评估某一维度时，她仍锚定于相应其他维度的参照点。这意味着她错误地将偏好交互视为与参照点相关。我展示了该模型在投资组合选择、消费组合选择及交换经济中的应用。

articles.abstract_en: I study a model of information acquisition and transmission in which the sender’s ability to misreport her findings is limited. The sender learns covertly, so a key observation is that in equilibrium she must be deterred from undetectably worsening the meaning of the messages she sends. This force substantially disciplines equilibrium beliefs and behavior: the receiver is maximally skeptical of what the sender claims and learns all discovered information. I exploit these equilibrium properties to characterize the sense in which the sender benefits from her claims being more verifiable , showing that this is akin to increasing her commitment power. Finally, I identify sender- and receiver-optimal falsification environments.
articles.abstract_cn: 我研究了一种信息获取和传输模型，其中发送者误报其发现的能力是有限的。发送者是秘密学习的，因此一个关键的观察结果是，在平衡状态下，她必须阻止她在无法察觉的情况下恶化她发送的消息的含义。这种力量极大地约束了平衡信念和行为：接收者对发送者声称的内容持最大程度的怀疑，并了解所有发现的信息。我利用这些均衡属性来描述发送者从其更可验证的声明中受益的感觉，表明这类似于增加她的承诺权力。最后，我确定了发送者和接收者最佳的伪造环境。

articles.title_en: The hold-up problem with flexible unobservable investments
articles.title_cn: 具有灵活不可观测投资的挟持问题
articles.abstract_en: The paper studies the canonical hold-up problem with one-sided investment by the buyer and full bargaining power by the seller. The buyer can covertly choose any distribution of valuations at a cost and privately observes her valuation. I show that, unlike in the well-understood case with linear costs, if investment costs are strictly convex, the buyer’s equilibrium utility is strictly positive and total welfare is strictly higher than when valuations are public information, thus alleviating the severity of the hold-up problem. In fact, when costs are mean-based or display decreasing risk, the equilibrium outcome might be efficient.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文研究了买方具有一单边投资且卖方拥有完全议价权的典型挟持问题。买方可以秘密选择任意估值分布，需支付成本，并私下观察其估值。我证明，与线性成本的已知情况不同，如果投资成本是严格凸的，买方的均衡效用严格为正，总福利严格高于估值为公开信息时的情况，从而缓解了挟持问题的严重性。事实上，当成本基于均值或表现出风险递减时，均衡结果可能是有效的。

articles.title_en: The Hard Problem and the Tyranny of the Losers
articles.abstract_en: A Hard Problem is a collective choice problem in which the only feasible alternatives to the status quo consist of a welfare gain to some people (the Winners) and a welfare loss to others (the Losers). These problems are typical in a number of settings, such as climate action, anti-trust regulation, and tax design. We study how to make collective choices when faced with Hard Problems. We find that a relatively weak fairness requirement, which we call Expansion Solidarity, necessarily leads to a dictatorship of the Losers, no matter how small their number. Even one single Loser must be given the power to veto any departure from the status quo, regardless of the number of Winners, how large the gains, how small the loss, or how extreme the welfare inequalities.
articles.abstract_cn: 难题是一种集体选择问题，其中对现状的唯一可行替代方案是部分人（赢家）福利增加而其他人（输家）福利减少。这类问题在多个情境中典型存在，如气候行动、反垄断监管和税收设计。我们研究在面临难题时如何做出集体选择。我们发现，一种相对较弱的公平性要求，即我们称之为扩展团结，必然导致输家的独裁，无论其人数多么少。即使只有单个输家，也必须赋予其否决任何偏离现状的权力，无论赢家人数多少、收益多大、损失多小或福利不平等多么极端。

articles.title_cn: 通过模仿学习：一项实验
articles.abstract_en: We compare how well agents aggregate information in two repeated social learning environments. In the first setting agents have access to a public data set. In the second they have access to the same data, and also to the past actions of others. Despite the fact that actions contain no additional payoff-relevant information, and despite potential herd behavior, free riding and information overload issues, observing and imitating the actions of others leads agents to take the optimal action more often in the second setting. We also investigate the effect of group size, as well as a setting in which agents observe private data and others’ actions.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们比较了代理人在二重复社会学习环境中聚合信息的效果。在第一环境中，代理人可以访问一个公共数据集。在第二环境中，他们不仅可以访问相同的数据，还可以观察他人的过去行为。尽管这些行为不包含额外的与收益相关的信息，且存在潜在的羊群效应、搭便车和信息过载问题，观察并模仿他人的行为仍使代理人在第二环境中更频繁地采取最优行动。我们还研究了群体规模的影响，以及代理人观察私人数据和他人行为的情形。

articles.abstract_en: We study pseudonymity—an information regime where agents’ histories are perfectly observable, but linked only to pseudonyms rather than to true identities. A key feature is that agents may open and use multiple pseudonyms simultaneously. In a tractable environment with limited commitment, we characterize the set of stationary credit equilibria under pseudonymity, showing that it forms a strict non-empty subset of equilibria attainable under a no anonymity regime, where histories are publicly linked to true identities. Moreover, money is always essential under pseudonymity, yet cannot co-exist with credit. Finally, imposing optimal fees on pseudonym creation generally raises welfare, whereas making pseudonyms tradable never does.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究伪匿名性——一种信息制度，其中代理人的历史记录是完全可观察的，但仅与伪名相关联，而非真实身份。一个关键特征是代理人可以同时开设并使用多个伪名。在一个具有有限承诺能力的可处理环境中，我们刻画了伪匿名性下的平稳信用均衡集合，表明该集合是无匿名制度下可达均衡的一个严格非空子集，在无匿名制度中，历史记录公开关联真实身份。此外，货币在伪匿名性下始终是必需的，但不能与信用共存。最后，对伪名创建施加最优费用通常会提高福利，而使伪名可交易则从未提高福利。

articles.title_en: Information design with endogenous state verification
articles.title_cn: 具有内生状态验证的信息设计
articles.abstract_en: We study a persuasion problem in which the receiver has the ability to probabilistically verify the state at a cost. The sender wants to convince the receiver to accept a project, but the receiver is only willing to accept the project when its quality is above a threshold. The optimal disclosure policy strikes a balance between influencing the receiver’s decisions to accept and to verify the quality. It is deterministic and involves at most three messages, each consisting of an acceptance recommendation and a verification recommendation. Under the optimal disclosure policy, the acceptance recommendation exhibits a cutoff structure, while the verification recommendation exhibits a negative assortative structure. Specifically, the optimal disclosure policy recommends acceptance when the quality exceeds a certain threshold. When the quality falls below this threshold, rejection without verification is recommended. For qualities above the threshold, verification is not recommended if the quality lies within the middle range of the interval. Using the characterization of the optimal disclosure policy, we conduct comparative statics and show that verification is recommended when the probability of successful verification is moderate.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究了一个说服问题，其中接收者能够以一定成本对状态进行概率性验证。发送者希望说服接收者接受一个项目，但接收者仅在项目质量高于某一阈值时才愿意接受该项目。最优披露策略在影响接收者接受决策与验证质量决策之间取得平衡。该策略是确定性的，最多包含三条信息，每条信息包括一个接受建议和一个验证建议。在最优披露策略下，接受建议呈现截断结构，而验证建议呈现负配对结构。具体而言，当质量超过某一阈值时，最优披露策略建议接受；当质量低于该阈值时，建议拒绝且不进行验证。对于高于阈值的质量，如果质量位于区间的中间范围内，则不建议进行验证。利用最优披露策略的特征，我们进行了比较静态分析，结果表明当成功验证的概率处于中等水平时，建议进行验证。

articles.title_en: The VCG mechanism, the core, and assignment stages in auctions
articles.title_cn: VCG机制、核心与拍卖中的分配阶段
articles.abstract_en: The Vickrey-Clarke-Groves (VCG) mechanism is one of the most compelling constructs in mechanism design, but the presence of complementary goods creates the possibility of non-core and even zero-revenue outcomes. In this article, we show that joint feasibility constraints on allocations offer a second pathway to ill-behaved outcomes in the VCG mechanism, even when all bidders have substitutes preferences for the goods. We then develop a theory of complementarities specifically tailored to assignment stages of spectrum auctions. Assignment stages typically guarantee contiguous spectrum to each winner—this proves to be an especially severe joint feasibility constraint. We propose a definition of bidder complementarities and further dichotomize them as direct or indirect. When opponents bid on distinct parts of a bidder’s preferred assignment, they set up a direct bidder complementarity. However, if an assignment is denied through the contiguity restriction, that is called an indirect complementarity. As a result, non-core outcomes, together with all of the accompanying anomalies, can be expected in VCG assignment stages. We then examine a conspicuous recent spectrum auction, the FCC’s Broadcast Incentive Auction, and we provide the first documentation of zero-revenue outcomes in the field. Of 207 assignment stage auctions with at least three bidders, 17.9% produced non-core outcomes relative to the bids and, of these, 3 generated zero revenues. After rescaling bidder values, we find that the majority of assignment stage auctions had the potential for exploitable bidder complementarities and that the vast majority of bidder complementarities—both potential and realized—were indirect.
articles.abstract_cn: Vickrey-Clarke-Groves (VCG) 机制是机制设计中最具吸引力的构造之一，但互补品的存在会导致非核心甚至零收入的结果。在本文中，我们表明，即使所有竞标者对商品都有替代偏好，分配的联合可行性约束也为VCG机制中的不良结果提供了第二条途径。然后，我们针对频谱拍卖的分配阶段，发展了一套专门的互补性理论。分配阶段通常保证每个赢家获得连续的频谱——这被证明是一种特别严格的联合可行性约束。我们提出了竞标者互补性的定义，并进一步将其划分为直接或间接互补性。当对手对竞标者偏好的分配的不同部分出价时，他们建立了直接竞标者互补性。然而，如果通过连续性限制拒绝了分配，则称为间接互补性。因此，在VCG分配阶段，可以预期非核心结果，以及所有伴随的异常现象。然后，我们研究了一个显著的近期频谱拍卖，即FCC的广播激励拍卖，并首次记录了现场的零收入结果。在207个至少有三个竞标者的分配阶段拍卖中，17.9%相对于出价产生了非核心结果，其中3个产生了零收入。在重新调整竞标者价值后，我们发现大多数分配阶段拍卖都有可利用的竞标者互补性，并且绝大多数竞标者互补性——无论是潜在的还是已实现的——都是间接的。

articles.title_en: Credit rationing in unsecured debt markets
articles.title_cn: 无担保债务市场的信贷配给
articles.abstract_en: We revisit the welfare properties of competitive credit markets with endogenousdebt limits that arise from limited commitment. We introduce a novel concept ofconstrained efficiency to encompass economies where market interest rates influencedefault values and participation constraints. We explore this concept through a baselineeconomy featuring heterogeneous agents with cyclical endowments. The analysis showsthat the efficiency of market equilibria and welfare outcomes are sensitive to the natureof default punishments. It suggests that laissez-faire debt limits, while supportiveof risk-sharing, might not always optimize welfare. The study illustrates how creditrationing—tightening future debt limits—can enhance current risk-sharing and overallwelfare. This occurs because such interventions influence market interest rates andthe default option’s value, thereby affecting agents’ present consumption and savingchoices, and enabling a more efficient allocation of resources.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们重新审视竞争性信贷市场的福利属性，以及因有限承诺而产生的内生债务限制。我们引入了一种新的约束效率概念，以涵盖市场利率影响违约值和参与约束的经济体。我们通过具有周期性禀赋的异质主体的基线经济来探索这个概念。分析表明，市场均衡的效率和福利结果对违约惩罚的性质很敏感。它表明，自由放任的债务限制虽然支持风险分担，但可能并不总是优化福利。该研究说明了信贷配给（收紧未来债务限额）如何能够增强当前的风险分担和整体福利。出现这种情况是因为此类干预会影响市场利率和默认期权的价值，从而影响代理人当前的消费和储蓄选择，并实现更有效的资源配置。

articles.title_en: Positive and negative selection in bargaining
articles.title_cn: 讨价还价中的正向选择与负向选择
articles.abstract_en: In the standard dynamic screening problem between an uninformed seller and a privately informed buyer, theory suggests that the presence (absence) of the buyer’s outside option leads to a substantial surplus for the seller (buyer). This outcome arises from contrasting unraveling processes that theory predicts: negative selection occurs in the absence of an outside option, while positive selection occurs in the presence of it. We examine the validity of these contrasting unraveling processes and report laboratory data that qualitatively deviate from theoretical predictions. We found that the seller’s profit ranking was reversed between the two environments. In particular, in the presence of an outside option, the buyer frequently rejected current-round offers, leading to pervasive delays; and the seller’s reported beliefs about the buyer’s type were qualitatively more consistent with the negative selection than with the theoretically predicted positive selection.
articles.abstract_cn: 在无信息卖方与私有信息买方之间的标准动态筛选问题中，理论表明买方外部选择权的存在（缺失）会导致卖方（买方）获得显著的剩余。该结果源于理论预测的两种截然不同的剥离过程：在无外部选择权时发生负向选择，而在有外部选择权时发生正向选择。我们检验了这两种截然不同剥离过程的有效性，并报告了实验室数据，这些数据在定性上偏离理论预测。我们发现卖方利润排序在不同环境（二）间发生了逆转。特别是在存在外部选择权的情况下，买方频繁拒绝当前轮次的报价，导致普遍的延迟；且卖方关于买方类型的报告信念在定性上更符合负向选择，而非理论上预测的正向选择。

articles.title_en: Nonbossy mechanisms: Mechanism design robust to secondary goals
articles.title_cn: 非专横机制：对次要目标稳健的机制设计
articles.abstract_en: We study mechanism design when agents may have hidden secondary goals which will play a role when the primary utility of the outcomes is the same. We show that in such cases, a mechanism is immune to strategic manipulation if and only if it is incentive compatible with regard to primary utility -- a property we term "primary incentive compatibility" -- and nonbossy -- a well-studied property in the context of matching and allocation mechanisms. We give complete characterizations of primarily incentive-compatible and nonbossy mechanisms in various settings, including auctions with single-parameter agents and public decision settings where all agents share a common outcome. In particular, we show that in the single-item setting, a mechanism is primarily incentive compatible, individually rational, and nonbossy if and only if it is a sequential posted-price mechanism.
articles.abstract_cn: 当代理人可能有隐藏的次要目标时，我们研究机制设计，当结果的主要效用相同时，这些次要目标将发挥作用。我们表明，在这种情况下，一种机制不受战略操纵的影响，当且仅当它与主要效用（我们称之为“主要激励相容性”）的激励相容，并且非专横（在匹配和分配机制的背景下经过充分研究的特性）。我们给出了各种环境中主要激励兼容和非专横机制的完整特征，包括单参数代理的拍卖和所有代理共享共同结果的公共决策环境。特别是，我们表明，在单项设置中，当且仅当一种机制是顺序定价机制时，该机制主要是激励兼容的、个体理性的和非专横的。

articles.abstract_en: Perfect equilibrium and its refinements are widely studied and typically rely on full-support perturbations. We introduce a δ-localized notion of perfection for games with a continuum of players. It confines perturbations within a δ-neighborhood of the underlying action distribution and eliminates undesirable equilibria from a local perspective. We establish the existence of a pure strategy δ-localized perfect equilibrium and show that it is equivalent to δ-admissible Nash equilibrium. We also study limit versions of δ-localized perfection. Illustrative applications to large routing games and crowd saturation games are presented.
articles.abstract_cn: 完美均衡及其精炼概念被广泛研究，通常依赖于全支持扰动。我们引入了适用于具有连续玩家的博弈的δ-局部完美概念。该概念将扰动限制在基础行动分布的δ邻域内，并从局部视角消除不良均衡。我们证明了纯策略δ-局部完美均衡的存在性，并表明其等价于δ-可接受纳什均衡。我们还研究了δ-局部完美的极限版本。文中展示了该概念在大规模路径选择博弈和人群饱和博弈中的应用示例。

articles.title_en: Asymmetric optimal auction design with loss-averse bidders
articles.title_cn: 具有厌恶损失的投标人的非对称最优拍卖设计
articles.abstract_en: We study optimal auctions with expectation-based loss-averse bidders. We first consider when bidders are ex-ante identical. Although symmetric designs are optimal for bidders with expected-utility preferences, if the degree of loss aversion is sufficiently large relative to the variation in valuations, expected revenues are higher in the optimal design with one buyer than in any symmetric mechanism with multiple bidders. Further, we provide a sufficient condition under which optimal mechanisms are necessarily asymmetric. When bidders are ex-ante heterogeneous, the optimal degree of favoritism must be modified from the level in Myerson (1981) to reduce the uncertainty in auction outcomes. Not only the degree of the required modification but also the direction of the modification may not be monotone in the degree of loss aversion.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究基于期望的、厌恶损失的投标人的最优拍卖。我们第一考虑投标人事前相同的情况。尽管对称设计对于具有预期效用偏好的投标人来说是最优的，但如果损失厌恶程度相对于估值变化足够大，则一买家的最优设计中的预期收入高于任何具有多个投标人的对称机制。此外，我们提供了一个充分条件，在该条件下最优机制必然是不对称的。当投标人事前存在异质性时，必须根据 Myerson（1981）的水平修改最佳偏袒程度，以减少拍卖结果的不确定性。损失厌恶程度不仅需要修改的程度，而且修改的方向也可能不是单调的。
